title: Sinkhorn Linearization and the Spectral Proxy: Unifying the Statistical and Algorithmic Theory of Feature-Parameterized Inverse Optimal Transport via a Single Spectral Sandwich
abstract: arXiv:2608.13201v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We develop the statistical and algorithmic theory of inverse optimal transport (IOT) under the feature-parameterized cost C_theta(i,j) = -theta^T phi(i,j). The core technical contribution is the Sinkhorn linearization -- the implicit-function sensitivity of the entropic OT plan to the cost -- together with its spectral proxy, a formula that is spectrally exact yet geometrically transparent.   The restricted Hessian on the tangent space satisfies the spectral sandwich (pi_min/epsilon) I <= H_T^{-1} <= (pi_max/epsilon) I, yielding the single core bound sigma_min >= (pi_min/(a_max epsilon)) sqrt(lambda_min(Sigma)) that drives the entire theory. On this core we establish four theorems and one observation.   T1 (identifiability): theta is globally injective on the quotient of the gauge kernel, with dimension bound F <= (K-1)^2. T2 (sparsistency): the l1-penalized estimator recovers the true support under irrepresentability and score concent

translated_title: Sinkhorn线性化与谱代理：通过单一谱夹逼统一特征参数化逆最优传输的统计与算法理论
translated_abstract: 我们发展了在特征参数化代价C_theta(i,j) = -theta^T phi(i,j)下的逆最优传输（IOT）的统计与算法理论。核心技术贡献是Sinkhorn线性化——熵最优传输计划对代价的隐函数敏感性——以及其谱代理，一个谱精确但几何透明的公式。切线空间上的受限Hessian满足谱夹逼(pi_min/epsilon) I <= H_T^{-1} <= (pi_max/epsilon) I，从而得到驱动整个理论的核心界sigma_min >= (pi_min/(a_max epsilon)) sqrt(lambda_min(Sigma))。在此核心上，我们建立了四个定理和一个观察。T1（可辨识性）：theta在规范核的商空间上全局单射，维度界为F <= (K-1)^2。T2（稀疏一致性）：在不可表示性和分数集中条件下，l1惩罚估计器能恢复真实支持。
tldr: 本文通过Sinkhorn线性化和谱代理提出了一个统一的谱夹逼框架，为特征参数化逆最优传输提供了核心理论界，并据此建立了可辨识性、稀疏一致性等四个关键定理。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a unified spectral sandwich framework via Sinkhorn linearization and spectral proxy, providing core theoretical bounds for feature-parameterized inverse optimal transport, and establishes four key theorems including identifiability and sparsistency.
